duration.text: The System of Smart Substances at Donghua University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5138 USD/In total ￥ 37000 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.HSK Certificate 6.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7.Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief. 8.Photocopies of personal artwork Original copies of 2 latest works of art, one in pencil sketch and the other in color painting, are required by the programs of Study of Design Art 9.Other materials Other requisite certificates or materials, such as testimonials. 10.Copy of visa Only for students who have already be in China

requirements.text: The applicant should meet the following conditions: 1.Non-Chinese citizen in good health 2.Holder of Bachelor's degree in correlated disciplines under the age of 45
